body:
## Why (verified evidence)

When a PR carries `agent:auto`, keepalive's first round ignores both the PR's concrete `agent:<name>` label and the Orchestrator route-weights export, and always runs the registry default agent. The opener lane is about to label every PR it creates `agent:auto` alongside its concrete label, so the route weights get consulted on stalls. Until this is fixed, every Claude-lane opener PR (`claude/issue-*`, `agent:claude`) will run codex from round 1. The choice also sticks, because the policy persists it as `current_agent`.

Verified on `main` at f0b58fc. `templates/consumer-repo/.github/scripts/agent_delegation_policy.js` is byte-identical to the root copy, and `.github/sync-manifest.yml:361` syncs the root copy to consumers.

- `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js:2621-2637`: since #2268, when `agent:auto` is present the concrete label is filtered out before `resolveAgentRoutingFromLabels`, so routing mode is `auto`.
- `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js:2715-2748`: in auto mode the loop loads the export (`loadRouteWeights`, :2737) and calls `decideNextAgent` with the full label list, the export and the round kind. The concrete label and the export both reach the policy.
- `.github/scripts/agent_delegation_policy.js:290-301`: with no `state.current_agent`, the policy returns `registry.default_agent` if available, else `availableAgents[0]`. It sets reason `initial-selection` and `delegationSource: 'static'`, and uses neither the labels nor `routeWeights`.
- `.github/scripts/agent_delegation_policy.js:347-394`: the export is consulted only in the stall branch, through `selectAgentFromRouteWeights` (:169-209). That branch is unreachable before round 5, because `inCooldown = iteration - last_switch_iteration < 5` (:319-320) and `last_switch_iteration` starts at 0. Measured on 159 opener-branch PRs merged since 2026-09-08 that have keepalive state: 14 reached iteration 5.
- `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js:4391-4418`: the chosen agent is persisted as `newState.current_agent`, so a wrong initial choice is kept for the life of the PR.
- `.github/scripts/agent_delegation_policy.js:574-593`: `getExplicitAgentFromLabels` already returns the concrete agent while skipping `agent:auto` and the control labels. It is called only on the no-auto path (:243).

## Tasks

- [ ] `.github/scripts/agent_delegation_policy.js:290-301`: when `currentAgent` is empty, choose the first agent in this order.
  1. The co-present concrete label from `getExplicitAgentFromLabels(labels, agents)` (:574), if that agent is in `availableAgents`. Return reason `initial-selection-label`, `delegationSource: 'static'`, `shouldSwitch: false`. The export's `reserve` is not consulted for this seed, so adding `agent:auto` to a labelled PR never changes its round-1 agent.
  2. Otherwise, when `routeWeights.task_types[taskType].evidence_ok === true`, the agent from `selectAgentFromRouteWeights({ routeWeights, taskType, currentAgent: '', availableAgents, agents })` (:169). Return reason `initial-selection-route-weights`, `delegationSource: 'route_weights'`.
  3. Otherwise, today's rule unchanged: `defaultAgent` if available, else `availableAgents[0]`, reason `initial-selection`, `delegationSource: 'static'`.
- [ ] Compute `taskType` once from `roundKind`, the same way as :350, so the initial branch and the stall branch map the round kind identically.
- [ ] Copy the resulting file byte-for-byte to `templates/consumer-repo/.github/scripts/agent_delegation_policy.js`.
- [ ] `docs/LABELS.md` and `templates/consumer-repo/docs/LABELS.md`, `agent:auto` section: replace effect item 4's "if no current agent is recorded, the policy chooses the default available agent or the first available alternative" with the three-step order above.
- [ ] In the same section, replace the Prerequisites bullet "any co-present concrete `agent:<name>` label is silently ignored" with "a co-present concrete `agent:<name>` label seeds the first round's agent, and the delegation policy decides after that". Keep the phrase "`agent:auto` always wins" and the phrase "alongside the existing `agent:<name>` label": `tests/docs/test_labels_agent_auto_coexistence.py` pins both.
- [ ] `docs/keepalive/GoalsAndPlumbing.md:106`: state that `decideNextAgent` also consults the export for the first choice on an `agent:auto` PR that has no concrete label, with the same fail-open fallback.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Named tests, added to `.github/scripts/__tests__/agent_delegation_policy.test.js` and using its `mockRegistry`, `mockSecrets` and `freshRouteWeights` fixtures:
  - `initial selection seeds from a co-present concrete label`: `state: {}`, `labels: ['agent:auto', 'agent:claude']`, `routeWeights: freshRouteWeights`. Asserts agent `claude`, reason `initial-selection-label`, `delegationSource` `static`. Claude is reserved in the fixture, which proves the seed ignores `reserve`.
  - `initial selection uses route weights without a concrete label`: `labels: ['agent:auto']`, `routeWeights: freshRouteWeights`. Asserts agent `cursor`, reason `initial-selection-route-weights`, `delegationSource` `route_weights`.
  - `initial selection falls back to the default agent without evidence`: `labels: ['agent:auto']`, with `evidence_ok: false` for implement. Asserts agent `codex`, reason `initial-selection`, `delegationSource` `static`.
  - `initial selection skips an unavailable concrete label`: `labels: ['agent:auto', 'agent:claude']`, secrets without `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `routeWeights: freshRouteWeights`. Asserts agent `cursor` and `delegationSource` `route_weights`.
- The existing tests stay green unchanged: `decideNextAgent returns default agent on initial selection` (`agent-delegation-policy.test.js:269`) and the initial case in `decideNextAgent always returns delegationSource on static return paths` (`agent_delegation_policy.test.js:411-420`).
- `node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/*.test.js` passes, as run by `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml:268`.
- `diff .github/scripts/agent_delegation_policy.js templates/consumer-repo/.github/scripts/agent_delegation_policy.js` prints nothing.
- `python -m pytest tests/docs` passes.
- Deliberate-break then revert, first case: restore :290-301 to the default-only rule. `initial selection seeds from a co-present concrete label` and `initial selection uses route weights without a concrete label` must FAIL. Revert and all pass.
- Deliberate-break then revert, second case: drop the `evidence_ok` requirement from step 2. `initial selection falls back to the default agent without evidence` must FAIL. Revert and all pass.

## Non-Goals

- Do NOT change the stall, cooldown or effectiveness rules (:316-394), including the 5-round cooldown that applies before the first switch. That is a separate decision.
- Do NOT change `resolveAgentRoutingFromLabels` (`agent_registry.js:299-349`) or the #2268 label filter at `keepalive_loop.js:2621-2637`.
- Do NOT add or remove labels from the policy. It still selects a runner without mutating labels.
- No scaffolding or TODO-only changes. Every task is a concrete edit verified by the gate above.

_Surfaced by an owner-directed session on 2026-09-22 that turns on `agent:auto` for opener PRs. Verified by reading `main` at f0b58fc, running `node --test` on both delegation test files (51 pass on main), and reading the keepalive state of the 10 PRs that carried `agent:auto` in the last 60 days. None recorded a switch or reached iteration 3._
title: [P1] decideNextAgent ignores a co-present concrete label and the route weights on an agent:auto PR's first round
